name: markdown
title: Markdown text
description: The one Markdown renderer (D-023): a fixed subset to safe HTML, with no DOM. Card bodies and the saved note use it now; replies, the chat and parking bundles call the same function later. Anything outside the subset shows as plain text, and raw HTML is always escaped.

files.blocks: blocks.ts (parseBlocks: lines into paragraphs, lists, # headings, > quotes, fenced code; with more, thematic breaks and where a table starts and ends)
files.inline: inline.ts (renderInline: bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code, links, autolinks, escapes, hard breaks; esc)
files.render: render.ts (renderMarkdown, the front function, whose options are headingLevel, images (the cardImages flag), svg (the svgImages flag), imageRoute and more (the markdownMore flag), each given by whoever renders; MARKDOWN_MAX)
files.image: image.ts (imageMarkup: what ![alt](path) becomes, after imagePathProblem, packages/format; imageNote and IMAGE_NOTE: the box saying why)
files.styles: markdown.css (the vb-md-* classes; tokens only; imported by the page beside node.css). Paragraphs, lists, quotes, tables and the large and medium headings read --vb-md-text, which a popover sets to --vb-pop-text (popovers-larger-thread); else --vb-text-md
files.table: table.ts (GFM tables: splitRow, delimiterRow, headerFits, tableHtml; MAX_COLUMNS, 4)

subset.paragraphs: blank-line separated; soft breaks; a hard break after two spaces or a backslash
subset.lists: - * + bullets and 1. 1) numbers, one level of nesting; deeper lists are plain text led by their marker
subset.headings: # large, ## medium, ### to ###### the small label, all role=heading at headingLevel (default 4: the card title is an h3); markdownMore off: every level the label
subset.quotes: > lines, drawn as the callout (01b .reply without its who line)
subset.code: ``` or ~~~ fences; the info string is dropped; capped height, scrolls, focusable
subset.images: ![alt](path), path relative to the project's .visionboard/images/ (subfolders too): the image when imagePathProblem passes and the alt text is there; a refused path is the box; no alt text is the path as plain text; with images off (the cardImages flag), the source text; an svg is an like any other, never inline markup, so its script never runs (D-064; svgImages flag off: refused)
subset.tables: GFM: the paragraph's last line is the header row, then a delimiter row (dashes, colons for alignment) with as many cells, then rows until a blank line or another block; at most 4 columns (5 or more stay text); inline Markdown in cells, \| for a pipe; a card with one is L (sizeTier); markdownMore off: text
subset.breaks: ---, *** or ___ (three or more, spaces between) on a line of its own; setext headings are not supported, so --- under a paragraph line is a break; markdownMore off: text
subset.plain text: HTML blocks, setext headings, reference links, indented code, entities

classes.vb-md-h1: span role=heading aria-level: a # heading, two type-scale steps above the text (xl over md)
classes.vb-md-h2: span role=heading aria-level: a ## heading, one step above (lg over md)
classes.vb-md-label: span role=heading aria-level: a ### to ###### label (01b .lbl); every level with markdownMore off
classes.vb-md-list: ul or ol (with start when not 1): a list (01b .ul, bold in the strong ink)
classes.vb-md-code: pre tabindex=0 > code: a fenced code block
classes.vb-md-table: table > thead > tr > th scope=col, then tbody > tr > td: the table's width, laid out as a grid of minmax(0, auto) columns that follow their content; cells wrap and a word breaks only when it alone is wider than its column; never scrolls
classes.vb-md-left: th or td: a column aligned by :-- (and vb-md-center :-:, vb-md-right --:)
classes.vb-md-rule: hr: a thematic break, one line in --vb-line-strong
classes.vb-md-link: a href rel=noopener noreferrer target=_blank: http, https and mailto only
classes.vb-md-img: img src=<imageRoute, default /board-images/><path> alt loading=lazy decoding=async: the one image shape; never wider than what holds it, at most 1.5 card widths tall, a sunken 16 by 10 box until its size is known (the page then adds width and height)
classes.vb-md-noimg: span: "Image not found: <path>" or "Image not shown: <path> (<reason>)", the reason in IMAGE_WORDS' words; the path in a code element

safety: Every text run escapes & < > " ' before markup is added. Links keep only http:, https: and mailto: (anything else is its text). An image only ever names the board's image route, and only for a path imagePathProblem passes (no scheme, no .., no leading / or ., no backslash, no %): nothing from the internet. Input over MARKDOWN_MAX (20,000) characters is cut with an ellipsis. Table rows are split once each, and a row is never wider than its header (at most 4 cells). Linear time: tested at 20,000 adversarial characters under 50 ms.
whenToUse: Any text a person or the agent writes that is shown on the board: card bodies, notes, later replies and the chat.
whenNotToUse: Titles, labels, tags and other one-line fields: those stay plain text through esc().
accessibility: Headings are below the card title (aria-level), whatever their size. Lists, quotes, links and tables are real elements; a table's header cells are th scope=col. A code block is focusable so a keyboard user can scroll it. Links open in a new tab.
